name: alfred
description: alfred_ works across your connected email, calendar and to-dos: find and read threads, check your schedule, draft and send replies, and keep track of what you owe.

interface.longDescription: alfred_ is a work assistant that holds your connected email accounts, calendars and to-dos. Search mail across every account, read full threads, check your schedule and find open time, save drafts, send replies after you confirm them, organize your inbox, and manage to-dos.
defaultPrompt: Use alfred_ to show what needs a reply in my inbox.
Use alfred_ to prep me for tomorrow's meetings.
Use alfred_ to find my last thread with a contact.
